title: Automation graph
description: Typed nodes and edges over which vstack checks its invariants. Node types: S source (system of record, read-only), C cache (content-addressed evidence), W writer (pure skill), G gate (pure critic), D draft sink (waits for a human click), L ledger (append-only), B bot (memory partition hosting cells). Edge types: reads, writes, gates, lands, records, delegates.

cells.description: for B nodes: cell ids this bot hosts
